data.name: Jalalatun
data.gender_notes: Jalalatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'jalal' which means 'beauty, elegance, and majesty'. The name Jalalatun is often given to a girl to symbolize her inherent beauty and grace. The name Jalalatun carries the meaning “Elegance, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jalalatun usually hope their child will grow to embody elegance, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jalalatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegance, Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jalalatun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
